Name: Unblock Sender by Message ID
Author: admin
Description: Action will get as a parameter a list of message IDs, and will be able to unmark it as junk. Unmarking an item as junk using this action will remove the item sender's mail address from the "Blocked Senders List". To move it back to the inbox, please tick the appropriate checkbox in the action parameters. NOTICE - to unmark emails in all mailboxes, please configure impersonation permissions: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/client-developer/exchange-web-services/impersonation-and-ews-in-exchange. NOTE: Action is running as async, please adjust script timeout value in Siemplify IDE for action as needed. NOTE: Action is supported only from Exchange Server version 2013 and newer, if a lower version is used, action will fail with the appropriate message.

AIDescription:
Unmarks specified emails as junk in Microsoft Exchange mailboxes, which removes the sender's email address from the 'Blocked Senders List'. This action can process emails based on a list of Message IDs or by using filters such as Subject, Sender, and Recipient within a specific time frame. It also supports moving the unblocked emails from the Junk folder back to the Inbox. The action runs asynchronously to handle large numbers of mailboxes in batches.

### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Move items back to Inbox? | Boolean | Yes | If true, moves the unblocked messages to the Inbox folder. |
| Message IDs | String | No | Comma-separated list of message IDs to unmark as junk. If provided, Subject, Sender, and Recipient filters are ignored. |
| Mailboxes list to perform on | String | No | Comma-separated list of specific mailboxes to process. |
| Folder Name | String | No | The folder(s) to search for emails (default: 'Junk Email'). Supports subfolders using '/' separator. |
| Subject Filter | String | No | Filter emails by subject. |
| Sender Filter | String | No | Filter emails by sender address. |
| Recipient Filter | String | No | Filter emails by recipient address. |
| Unmark All Matching Emails | Boolean | No | If true, processes all matching emails; otherwise, only the first match. |
| Perform action in all mailboxes | Boolean | No | If true, searches all accessible mailboxes (requires impersonation permissions). |
| How many mailboxes to process in a single batch | Integer | No | Number of mailboxes to process per async iteration (default: 25). |
| Time Frame (minutes) | Integer | No | Lookback period for searching emails. |

### Additional Notes
- This action requires Exchange Server version 2013 or newer.
- To perform actions across all mailboxes, impersonation permissions must be configured in Exchange.

### Flow Description
1. **Initialization**: Connects to the Exchange server and validates that the server version is 2013 or newer.
2. **Mailbox Discovery**: Identifies the target mailboxes based on the 'Mailboxes list' or 'Perform action in all mailboxes' parameters.
3. **Search**: Searches the specified folders (e.g., Junk Email) for emails matching the provided Message IDs or the Subject/Sender/Recipient filters within the defined time frame.
4. **Remediation**: For each matching email found, it executes the Exchange 'Mark as Not Junk' operation, which removes the sender's address from the 'Blocked Senders List'.
5. **Relocation**: If the 'Move items back to Inbox?' parameter is enabled, the action moves the processed emails to the Inbox folder.
6. **Async Batching**: Processes mailboxes in batches to manage resource usage and prevent script timeouts, maintaining state across iterations until all mailboxes are processed.
